text:
ava: Hey finance — charged an 'Airport Lounge Upgrade' on the Redwood Corpcard last night (SFO). Statement shows $45 but lounge staff didn't give an itemized receipt. Do I submit for reimbursement or should we dispute? cc @sam
sam: Do you know if this was a business-approved lounge? If you used corpcard we usually need an itemized receipt or manager sign-off. If not, can you upload your boarding pass + a screenshot of the charge + a short justification?
ava: Tried to get one at the desk but they said it's digital only. I have a screenshot of the charge and my boarding pass. I can try to chase a merchant invoice but might not get it. Is a manager exception OK?
sam: :thumbsup: I approve the exception for business travel. Ava please mark it as "lounge upgrade" in the expense and include my approval in the notes. Filing note: manager approval for missing itemized receipt.
jordan: Hey @ava — finance here. Please upload this to Expensify under the 'Travel' policy with the boarding pass and screenshot, set category to 'Meals & Travel - Other'. If you'd prefer we dispute the charge instead of reimburse, tell us. Also include the corpcard last4 (e.g., `XXXX-1234`) in the expense note so we can match.
ava: Uploading now — report link: https://expensify.com/report/xyz (screenshot attached). Please reimburse, not dispute.
jordan: Reimburse OK. Note: with no itemized receipt reimbursement capped at $45, requires manager + finance approval which we have. We'll schedule it for the next payroll run; ETA ~10 business days. I'll tag when processed.
expensify-bot: Expense received for review: Report xyz, total $45, status 'Submitted' — awaiting finance approval.
jordan: Got it. @sam I recorded your approval. @ava please confirm the merchant descriptor on your statement matches the screenshot to avoid merchant-mismatch flags.
ava: Confirmed — statement shows 'SFO LOUNGE SVC' which matches the screenshot. Thanks!
